api_auth_failed: Hiddify’s local API rejected its saved key. Open the app’s server list.
invalid_backup: The backup is incomplete or invalid.
recovery_close_app: Close Hiddify before recovering the interrupted operation.
update_terminal_failed: Could not complete the Hiddify update. Check the terminal.
testing_servers: Latency testing started. Results update automatically.
api_unavailable: Server controls are unavailable. Connect Hiddify in VPN mode, or open its native server list.
updates_not_checked: Updates have not been checked yet.
update_check_failed: Could not check updates. Try again later.
update_version_unknown: Could not compare the installed version.
update_notification_body: Hiddify %1 · %2. Open the widget to update.
restarting: Closing Hiddify safely, applying changes and restarting…
installing: Downloading and installing Hiddify in the terminal. Enter your password there if requested.
not_installed: Hiddify is not installed. Installation starts automatically through Omarchy.
unsupported_version: This action is unavailable in this Hiddify version.
import_hint: HTTPS subscription link. Import restarts Hiddify.
start_first: Hiddify is starting. Connect once it is ready.
menu_not_ready: Hiddify is not ready, or its menu has changed. Open the app and retry.
close_app_first: Hiddify did not exit. No data was changed. Close it using Exit and retry.
invalid_settings: Invalid setting value. Check the edited fields.
invalid_option: This setting does not support the selected value.
invalid_range: Enter a number or an ordered range, for example 10-30.
settings_changed: The app changed these settings. Discard edits, refresh and try again.
invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS subscription URL without a username or password in the host.
subscription_too_large: The subscription exceeds the 8 MB limit.
invalid_subscription: Hiddify could not validate this subscription. Existing profiles were not changed.
download_failed: Could not download the subscription. Check the link and network connection.
profile_not_found: The profile no longer exists. Refresh the panel.
import_expired: The staged import expired. Import the URL again.
initialize_app: Open Hiddify once and finish its first-run setup before importing.
no_backup: There is no backup to restore.
operation_failed: The operation failed. Check Hiddify and retry.
file_too_large: The settings file is too large.
request_too_large: Too many changes in one request. Apply fewer changes at once.
